name: Badia del Vallès (Spain)
description: Vertical bicolour of yellow and green, charged over the division with the black swallow with a white breast of the arms, 5/7 of the height.
history: The flag was approved on 19 May 1998 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya on 6 November 1998; it is a heraldic flag following the pattern of the arms (approved 12 January 1996), an oblong flag of 2:3, vertical bicolour yellow and green, with the black swallow of the arms centred on the division.

features.role: swallow with a white breast, 5/7 of the height
